sentences.text: For Petitioner : Mr.S.Sugendran  Additional Public Prosec  ORDER

This Suo Motu Case is dealt with in an extraordinary manner by the Dedicated Bench, pursuant to Suo Motu.W.P.(Crl.) No.618 of 2025.
2.
The case was registered in Cr.No.6 of 2020 dated 02.01.2020.

After completion of investigation,
the case was charge-sheeted for the offence under Section 380 and 420 of Indian Penal Code, 1860.
The stolen two wheeler has already been recovered and returned to the defacto complainant.
It is submitted that the case is presently pending at the stage of summons.
The defacto complainant does not want to pursue the case any further.

3. Considering the factual matrix, context of the case, the antecedents of the accused, the reason for absence from his usual place, and the submission that, despite best efforts, the summons could not be executed, it is evident that even if the accused is brought to face trial, it would impinge upon his right to a speedy trial.
Due to the passage of time, a meaningful trial is unlikely, and no useful purpose would be served.

( Uploaded on: 05/11/2025 11:53:00 am ) D.BHARATHA CHAKRAVARTHY, J.
shl 4.
Accordingly, the case in CC.1561/2021 on the file of the Judicial Magistrate No- II, Coimbatore Taluk, Coimbatore shall stand quashed and this Suo Motu Transfer Case stand disposed of.
